Mitigation: Formulate precise endpoint charter at STEP-014 with qualified cardiologist sign-off
Contingency: Bound claims to early risk detection rather than lifetime incidence

Description: Post-diagnosis feature leakage or pre-split transform leakage
Mitigation: Strict separation of record-local cleaning from training-fitted scalers/imputers (FitStateHash)
Contingency: Enforce automated leakage unit tests at G07-G08

Description: Heterogeneous or noisy ECG signal formats and filter distortion of ST-T complexes
Mitigation: Standardize lead specs; mandate cardiologist morphology check before release
Contingency: Adjust notch/bandpass cutoff and document filter frequency response

Description: Small-N Transformer multimodal overfitting vs strong tabular GBDT baselines
Mitigation: Implement 4-tier baseline hierarchy (LR, RF, SVM, XGBoost, CNN, LSTM); pretraining/regularization
Contingency: Report findings honestly as rigorous Q1 comparative benchmarking even if baseline wins

Mitigation: Validation-only calibration (Brier/ECE/DCA); mandatory deletion/insertion faithfulness (AOPC) benchmarks
Contingency: Isolate shortcut variable and retrain; disclose limitations in PROBAST audit

Trigger: Accidental staging of clinical CSVs/ECG headers
Mitigation: Enforce Four-Tier storage model; strict .gitignore; diff inspection before every commit
Contingency: Execute immediate history purge and security protocol under OS §11.4
